periods.time: vol-09 ch-002, after Ikki's second-round treatment

name.zh: 黑铁严在医务室提出断绝亲子关系
name.en: Itsuki proposes severing parent-child ties in the infirmary

periods.summary: After comic chaos with Sara and Stella, Ikki's father Itsuki visits the infirmary and proposes ending his parent-child relationship with Ikki for the sake of the Kurogane family's order.
periods.cause: Ikki has become nationally visible as an F-rank top-eight fighter, making him harmful to the Kurogane family's rank-based public order from Itsuki's perspective.
periods.process: Stella catches Sara trying to undress sleeping Ikki and restrains her with bandages. Ikki wakes and jokes with Stella until Itsuki enters. After an awkward first meeting with Stella, Itsuki states that Ikki's existence will encourage others to defy their rank limits and therefore he is considering severance.
periods.outcome: Stella furiously condemns Itsuki, but Ikki asks her to stand down. Ikki refuses to answer immediately, admitting that although he expected such a day, he cannot instantly agree.
periods.aftermath: The unresolved father-son issue weighs on Ikki until Sara's later story gives him a new way to understand one-sided family love.
periods.significance: Turns Ikki's conflict with the Kurogane family into an immediate personal decision and lets Stella confront Ikki's father directly.
